embedding_policy: Frozen final-layer mean of amino-acid tokens only; float32 on CPU; one representation per sequence reused across tasks. No fine-tuning.
training_size_policy: A numeric size is included only if every outer fold across every regime and seed in that task has enough training examples. Subsets are nested and label-independent; all methods receive identical subsets.
aggregation: Equal weight per held-out fold, then per partition seed; separate tables for every task, regime and training size. No universal pooled winner.
scope: Retrospective single-study benchmark on natural enzyme constructs, not mutation-effect prediction or industrial validation. Warm neutral condition was explored in PET Scout before this extension; this is not a pristine prospective test.
